title: Fix example blobId to look like proper opaque identifier
description: The example blobId (line 139) 'G5be7a7-13f0-4b7c-bead-3c17de6812a2' has 7 hex chars in the first UUID segment instead of 8 (looks like a truncated UUID). Since blobId is opaque any string is valid, but the example looks like a copy-paste error to readers familiar with UUIDs. Either use a proper UUID example or a clearly non-UUID opaque string.
